quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (half-year report): communications product orders are full and capacity keeps ramping; new coating, molding, automated isolator-assembly and inspection equipment entered the Nanchang base in H1 2026 and isolator and Z-Block capacity is being released steadily; Nanchang lines run at a high utilization range. In H2 the company will prioritise releasing 1.6T-related device capacity, keeping flexible lines for 3.2T components. Optical isolators shipped in large, stable volume in H1, and multiple 1.6T isolators and WDM filters completed full reliability qualification at leading optical module customers with batch orders landing.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.6T isolators and WDM filters qualified at leading module customers; 1.6T capacity prioritised in H2

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customers (half-year report): its high-speed communications filters are among the few domestic products made at scale and are supplied in volume to leading domestic optical module makers, indirectly serving overseas cloud providers' compute equipment. New products in sampling or small-batch introduction: 3.2T WDM filters, silicon lens assemblies and turning prisms; micro-optics for CPO in R&D with several rounds of sample testing.
